description: Reads one job timeout from a workflow yaml with a build job look-alike and a disabled copy; bash allowed but one read suffices. DISTILL-CANARY-4ca6eae2

files.ci/release.yml:
name: release
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - run: make dist
  publish:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - run: ./publish.sh
files.ci/release.yml.disabled:
name: release-old
jobs:
  publish:
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - run: ./publish.sh
